description: This file contains functions and data structures for fetching and processing module attributes in PyTorch's FX graph transformation framework, including version compatibility checks and recursive attribute extraction for modules.

methods.name: default_matching
methods.description: Returns the attribute name unchanged, used as default matching method.

methods.name: extract_attrs_for_lowering
methods.description: Fetches module attributes for lowering, checking version compatibility.

methods.name: lift_lowering_attrs_to_nodes
methods.description: Recursively traverses FX graph nodes to fetch and assign module attributes for leaf modules.
